properties.name: Sync VLAN Profiles?
properties.description: Enable to copy VLAN profile configurations from the source network to destination networks. VLAN profiles define VLAN assignments and network segmentation policies.

Copies Meraki configuration from a source network to a set of destination networks matching a set of network tags. 
This Workflow is intended to provide a means of syncing configuration as an alternative to Configuration Templates.

Sections of configuration can be excluded by setting their respective input boolean to "false".

Note that not all network configuration is copied. The items included are those most likely to be identical across a group of networks.

Configuration copied includes:
- Network-wide settings (SNMP, Syslog, Netflow, Traffic Analysis)
- Group Policies
- VLAN Profiles
- SSIDs (access control, layer 7 firewall, traffic shaping, bonjour forwarding, splash page, schedules)
- Wireless Radio Profiles
- Security Appliance (layer 7 firewall, content filtering, IDS/IPS, AMP, firewalled services)
- Switch access policies (requires RADIUS server configuration at the org level)
